Review.Feedback:
1. The Title at the top of the home page ("Welcome to Acme..." is cutoff by the menu bar.  
2. The font size for the left-pane navigation is a little small. 
3. "Active org" above "Internal Operations" and to the left of SWITCH ORG seems like a bolted-on band-aid -- it's red font is hard to read against the purple background and I suspect that by having it above the "Internal Operations" text, that it threw off the alignment of the vertical bars that separate menu components.  Let's consider a change: how about something like the following ... where each component is a hyperlink that either brings up the login, brings up a popup that allows selecting a new Role and/or Organization. "Casey Hart as System Admin for Internal Operations"

Clicking on Retail Businesses in the left navigation pane takes you to the search screen, but ...
1. The URL isn't updated to ".../customers"  Note that this is a systemic issue for all navigation items
2. This may need to be an entry in the guiding principles or other centralized documentation... Duplicate tabs should be disallowed for the search screens for the same entity.  They can be allowed for displaying details for separate specific records
3. The left navigation pane styling needs work here.  When selected, the left pane navigation item's text should be visible.  Right now, the background color becomes purple and the text stays black/gray.  The next should become white or choose a better background color.  This should have been caught with the accessibility review ... we may need to make a note of this more generally.
